title: Quaint Tagine with Kabocha and Eastern Flair
description: Experience the warm, aromatic flavors of the Middle East with this delightful tagine recipe, featuring tender kabocha squash and a hint of quaint spices.

ingredients.name: eastern spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the quaintly spiced oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cubed kabocha squash and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Stir in the eastern spices and cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the flaky pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry over the skillet, pressing the edges to seal.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
